poses.caption: Support your body above the parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pressed down. Keep your feet clear of the floor and hold still for 15–30 seconds.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1442 DIP HOLD. ONE STATIC HOLD exactly ONE full body person at TOP SUPPORT of TWO PARALLEL DIP BARS, bodyweight no assistance. Front-side three-quarter view clearly shows BOTH arms and both grips. BOTH hands firmly grasp horizontal parallel gray rails beside hips, fingers wrap bars thumbs opposed wrists neutral, BOTH elbows FULLY STRAIGHT near torso. Shoulders actively DOWN away from ears, small forward torso lean neutral spine head aligned body, hips suspended BETWEEN bars not resting on rails. Knees bent behind and ankles gently crossed, BOTH feet AIRBORNE clearly above floor, whole body held still on hands. Realistic independent sturdy grounded metal parallel-bar frames with rails horizontal at hip height, NO bar through body or clothing, no seat or foot support. Primary BOTH exposed posterior upper-arm TRICEPS RED ONLY, shoulders chest forearms grayscale. Fine detailed grayscale exposed muscle contours realistic hands fingers proportions. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins whole head fingers feet entire bar supports within square uncropped. Equal male/female detailed quality.
